title: Per-chain deploy context
description: Names IPOR contracts by their ipor-abi key; addresses come from the vendored snapshot contexts/ipor-abi/<ipor_abi_deployment>.json (tools/refresh_ipor_abi.py) and fuses from the on-chain FuseWhitelist. A literal address appears only in pins (with a reason), external_addresses (third-party, with a source) and tokens.

ipor_abi_deployment.description: Directory under ipor-abi mainnet/ whose addresses.json is vendored as contexts/ipor-abi/<name>.json.

public_rpc.description: Read-only public endpoint for dry-runs when RPC_URL is unset; never used for --broadcast.

contracts.description: Root contracts by ipor-abi key. fusion_factory, price_oracle_middleware and fuse_whitelist are required; middleware_owner is used for fork impersonation only; morpho_blue and similar venue contracts may be named here when ipor-abi lists them.

standard_fuses.description: ipor-abi keys of the fuses the FusionFactory injects into every vault (e.g. BurnRequestFeeFuse), oldest first. Never declared in a strategy JSON; the verifier treats them as expected.

fuses.description: Fuse name used in strategies -> ipor-abi key, or null when ipor-abi has no entry and the name is a FuseWhitelist type name. The whitelist decides the address; ipor-abi is the fallback and the cross-check.

callback_handlers.description: Callback handler name -> ipor-abi key (e.g. CallbackHandlerMorpho).

pins.description: A fuse or pre-hook pinned to one address over the registries. Re-validated on every run: a pinned fuse must still be active on the FuseWhitelist.

external_addresses.description: Third-party contracts ipor-abi does not list (e.g. the Aave V3 pool), with where the address comes from.

markets.description: Market name -> id, for ids the SDK's IporFusionMarkets does not know.

tokens.description: Token symbol -> address (third-party ERC20s); the address report checks symbol() on-chain.
